title: risk: token DB compile-time count check should use _Static_assert
description: wp11_token_db.c uses extern char wp11_token_db_count_check[(WP11_TOKEN_DB_SIZE == 7u) ? 1 : -1] to enforce the token count. When this fails, the compiler error is 'array has negative size', which is cryptic. Replace with _Static_assert(WP11_TOKEN_DB_SIZE == 7u, 'Update expected token count in compile-time check after adding/removing tokens') for a human-readable error. Requires C11; fallback for C99 is the existing trick but with a better-named symbol.
